mentions.name: Vitamin network graph explorer
mentions.description: A vitamin exploration interface that renders vitamins in a network graph showing relationships; selecting one rearranges the graph around it into a valence-orbit style to explore chains of effect.
mentions.source_excerpt: A novel exploration interface for vitamins that renders them in a network graph, showing relationships. When you select one it rearranges around it into a kind of valance orbit style so you can explore chains of effect. Turns out, lots and lots of things relate to magnesium.
mentions.author: jhogendorn
